init_svd_volume: initialize SVD tensor factorization planes for density and appearance on a given device and resolution
compute_densityfeature: compute density features from sampled 4D spatiotemporal coordinates using grid sampling on space and time planes
compute_appfeature: compute appearance features from sampled 4D spatiotemporal coordinates using grid sampling on space and time planes
forward: render RGB images by performing volume rendering over sampled ray points with density and appearance features
getDenseAlpha: compute dense alpha volume across all frames by sampling a 3D grid and evaluating alpha values over time
